tree.heading: Deputy Administrators
tree.text: The President may appoint, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate, not more than 4 Deputy Administrators to assist the Administrator in carrying out this subchapter.

tree.heading: United States Fire Administration
tree.text: The Administrator of the United States Fire Administration shall have a rank equivalent to an assistant secretary of the Department.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Subsecs. (b), (c). Pub. L. 115–278 redesignated subsec. (c) as (b) and struck out former subsec. (b). Prior to amendment, text of subsec. (b) read as follows: “There is in the Department an Assistant Secretary for Cybersecurity and Communications.”

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Mar. 31, 2007, see section 614(b)(3) of Pub. L. 109–295, set out as a note under section 701 of this title.
